description: This repository contains a NetLogo agent-based model and supporting data, simulation outputs, experiment settings, validation scripts and plotting code. The model simulates intergovernmental competition for industrial investment, firm location choices, industrial land allocation and cross-scale cooperation policies. The MIT license applies to the authors' original model and analysis scripts as scoped in LICENSE_SCOPE.md.
